warp.bot: Use when the user wants to create a new product, material, or billable item with multiple variations/pricing tiers. Extract name, price, and variation names/SKUs/prices from their description. For example: '10 pieces at €4, 50 pieces at €3' becomes variations with different SKUs. For food or reduced VAT, pass taxClassId from tax-class-list. For nutrition/ingredients/specs, pass meta.details as a sections array (kind kv or text). Pass settings.configurator to add an optional customer input form on the product page. Set perishable to true for food that spoils quickly so statutory withdrawal is excluded.

en: Add a new product with a price to your shop catalog
Create a product with variations and volume pricing tiers
Create a product with nutrition or ingredient detail sections
de: Ein neues Produkt mit Preis zum Shop-Katalog hinzufügen
Ein Produkt mit Varianten und Mengenrabatt-Stufen erstellen
Ein Produkt mit Nährwert- oder Zutaten-Abschnitten anlegen

en.question: What do I need to create a product?
en.answer: A name and a price in cents. Unit, tags, description, and details are optional.

en.question: Can I add volume pricing?
en.answer: Yes. Add variations with different SKUs and prices for bulk or volume tiers.

en.question: How do I add nutrition or specs?
en.answer: Pass meta.details as sections with kind kv (label/value rows) or text (a block).

de.question: Was brauche ich, um ein Produkt zu erstellen?
de.answer: Einen Namen und einen Preis in Cent. Einheit, Tags, Beschreibung und Details sind optional.

de.question: Kann ich Mengenrabatte anlegen?
de.answer: Ja. Füge Varianten mit unterschiedlichen SKUs und Preisen für Mengenstufen hinzu.

de.question: Wie füge ich Nährwerte oder Specs hinzu?
de.answer: Übergib meta.details als Abschnitte mit kind kv (Label/Wert-Zeilen) oder text (Textblock).

warp.bot: Use when the user wants to change an existing product. Pass the product slug from list_products as product_id. PUT goes to /v1/products/{slug} — never the collection URL. Only include fields that change. Pass tags as [] to clear tags. Do not send price (price is on variations). To change VAT, pass taxClassId from tax-class-list. For nutrition/ingredients/specs, pass meta.details as a sections array (kind kv or text). To change the optional customer input form on the product page, pass settings.configurator. Set perishable to true for food that spoils quickly so statutory withdrawal is excluded.
